title: Seven Winters and One Short Pipe
subtitle: 污染治理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 污染治理（人与自然·环境保护与可持续发展）
meta: 主题语境：污染治理（人与自然·环境保护与可持续发展）　|　核心词汇：exhaust　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 exhaust 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1985 my father ① cut exhaust that no inspector in the street would have measured, and he said the cutting was the whole of the winter. The ② exhaust, meaning the fumes themselves and not the smoke, ran seven winters and stayed unmeasured in the book; exhaust, he said, is the only thing in a street that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ exhaust in that street had the same short pipe beside it, and the ④ exhaust at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the buses and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Exhaust, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; my father said the measuring is the part that fills seven winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the exhaust was the whole of the engine, meaning the release and not the fumes. The ⑥ exhaust, meaning the release and not any of that, is the only thing in an engine that everybody waits for and nobody measures; exhaust, he said, is either something you cut or the only word that means both fumes and a release. He said the release is the part they remember.

By 1991 the ⑦ exhaust had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short pipe. The ⑧ exhaust of the whole thing, my father wrote in January, was one street and seven winters of measuring; exhaust, he said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ exhaust I remember is the one measured in the report, which closed in 1994 and is still described as the quietest in the street. An ⑩ exhaust, my mother said in 1996, is the only one that improves by being measured; every exhaust, she said, is a release that has agreed to look like a set of fumes. She said the release was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 废气；尾气（指街上每一处旁边的那一处）
B. n. 废气（指那些尾气本身，与烟尘相对）
C. 固定搭配：cut exhaust 减少废气排放
D. n. 废气（指留给公共汽车管的那一处）
E. n. 废气（抽象总称，指一条街上的排放之事）
F. n. 废气（指报告上写到、被测出的那一处）
G. n. 排气；排出（指一台发动机里人人都等却无人计量的那样东西）
H. n. 排出（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人计量的那样东西）

items.q: cut exhaust that no inspector in the street would have measured
The exhaust, meaning the fumes themselves and not the smoke
the exhaust at the far side
the exhaust was the whole of the engine
the exhaust had become a line in a report
The exhaust of the whole thing
An exhaust, my mother said in 1996

answers.why: cut exhaust 意为“减少废气排放”，1985 年父亲减少了一处街上没有一位检查员肯计量的废气。
exhaust 意为“废气”，指那些尾气本身而不是烟尘，它经过了七个冬天而在簿子上没有数字。
exhaust 意为“废气”，指街上每一处旁边的那一处，每一处旁边都有同一根短短的管子。
exhaust 意为“废气”，指留给公共汽车管的那一处，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
exhaust 意为“排气、排出”，指一台发动机里人人都等却无人计量的那样东西，叔叔说这处排气就是那台发动机的全部。
exhaust 意为“排出”，指人人都等却无人计量的那样东西而不是那些尾气，是发动机里人人都等、却无人计量的东西。
exhaust 意为“废气”，指报告上写到、被测出的那一处，到 1991 年这一处成了报告里的一行。
exhaust 意为“废气”，父亲一月写道，整件事的排放之事是一条街和七个冬天的计量。
exhaust 意为“废气”，我记得的是报告上测出的那一处，1994 年结束了，至今仍被说成街上最安静的一处。
exhaust 为抽象总称，母亲 1996 年说，一处废气是唯一会因为被好好计量而变得更好的东西。
